import{useEffect,useState}from'react';/**
 * usePeerInfo retrieves the list of clustering peers from the API.
 *
 * @param fromPeer The peer requesting component info.
 */export const usePeerInfo=fromPeer=>{const[peers,setPeers]=useState([]);useEffect(function(){const worker=async()=>{const infoPath='./api/v0/web/peers';// Request is relative to the <base> tag inside of <head>.
const resp=await fetch(infoPath,{cache:'no-cache',credentials:'same-origin'});setPeers(await resp.json());};worker().catch(console.error);},[fromPeer]);return peers;};
